verdict.rationale: Salv Cases lets analysts work an investigation with notes and attached documents (evidence), alongside related alerts, customers and transactions, an assignee and a status. The docs do not explicitly describe recording decision reasons or a chronological investigation history for manual work; the only audit trail mentioned covers auto-closed alerts. missing for 10: explicit decision-reason capture on case or alert resolution, a documented investigation history/timeline of notes and actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can record evidence, notes and decision reasons in the investigation history

citations.quote: Open a case, attach the related alerts, customers and transactions, and work it with notes, documents, an assignee and a status
anyone opening that customer sees the investigation already under way
every auto-closed alert stays on the record as an audit trail
